payload.body: Compaction distilled-state is one empty marker file per segment under nahel/journal/distilled/ (marker name IS the record), not a single distilled.json — chosen during PR #13 review because a shared JSON file conflicts when parallel branches both distill (ADR-0012 merge safety); marker files union trivially. Distill journals write-ahead outside mutate() with idempotent union. Compaction thresholds: 200 events / 30 days (nahel/config compaction.*).
